reason: This plugin is primarily an external-services integration that lets users use ChatGPT/Codex models from DeepSeek Harness by adding an `openai-codex` provider and related configuration. Evidence in README and package metadata shows it provides OAuth login flows, token lifecycle commands, and streaming response handling as a DSH plugin with CLI commands, so the core user-facing purpose is connecting an external LLM service rather than standalone code generation or testing tooling.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于将 ChatGPT/Codex 接入 DeepSeek Harness，通过浏览器回调或设备码完成 OAuth 登录，并在本地管理凭据与配置以在 DSH 中使用模型对话和流式输出。
summaries.en: This plugin connects DeepSeek Harness to ChatGPT/Codex via OAuth, exposing model access in DSH while handling local credential lifecycle and streaming model outputs through the configured provider.

capabilities: ChatGPT/Codex OAuth authentication (PKCE browser callback and device-code)
Local OAuth credential file handling under DSH home path
OpenAI Codex API request/stream handling through DSH provider adapter
DSH CLI workflow for login, status, refresh, and logout

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as enabling ChatGPT OAuth and Codex model use inside DeepSeek Harness via browser callback and device-code flows, indicating external service access.
README details credential lifecycle behavior including auth.json storage and token refresh, which implies local token handling and potential credential sensitivity.
Package metadata exports a `dsh-chatgpt-codex` CLI entry and includes a DSH bundle patch, confirming integration and tool-level invocation paths.
